```{r Setup}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(matchingR)

# set base folder
here::i_am("allocation_round2.Rmd")

# Import utils and config
purrr::walk(
  list.files(here::here("utils"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
)
source(here("config.R"))
```

# Load and prepare data
```{r}
# Safely load topics
topics <- load_topics(here(topics_path))

print(topics)
```

```{r}
# Safely load supervisor preferences

supervisor_preferences <- load_supervisor_preferences(here(supervisor_preferences_path), topics$topic_id, student_preferences_round2$student_id)
print(supervisor_preferences)
```




```{r}
# Safely load student preferences

student_preferences_round2 <- load_student_preferences(here(student_preferences_round2_path), topics$topic_id)

print(student_preferences_round2)
```

# Allocate Students by Supervisor-Proposing Deferred Acceptance

```{r}
allocation_output <- allocate_by_da(
  student_prefs = student_preferences_round2, 
  supervisor_prefs = supervisor_preferences, 
  topics = topics
)
```

```{r}
#matches
allocations_round2 <- allocation_output$matches
print(allocations_round2)
```

```{r}
# unassigned students/topics
unassigned_round2 <- allocation_output$unassigned

print(unassigned_round2)
```

# Write output

```{r}
write_csv(allocations_round2, here(allocations_round2_path))
write_csv(unassigned_round2, here(unassigned_round2_path))
```
